links.outcome: Expert-rated clinical clarity and guideline concordance of evidence-grounded pipeline versus LLM baselines
links.effect: Evidence-grounded agentic system significantly outperformed GPT-5, Claude, and Grok in clinical clarity and guideline concordance on 24 random recommendations.
links.quote: In expert evaluations of 24 random recommendations, our system significantly outperformed leading LLM baselines (GPT-5, Claude, Grok) in clinical clarity and guideline concordance.

unlisted_practices: Agentic pipeline that retrieves full-text literature and FDA drug labels and aggregates evidence across studies to draft pharmacogenomic guideline recommendations

screen.reason: The study designs and benchmarks a novel modular agentic LLM pipeline for pharmacogenomic recommendation generation compared against baseline LLMs, evaluated offline by experts.
